title: "taxonomic_bar_plot"
author: "ChloeSaar"
date: "2026-03-22"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
#Stacked Bar Plot 
# Genus-level Stacked Bar Plot per Sample, Faceted by Farm Status

library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Aggregate to Genus level & transform to relative abundance
ps_genus <- tax_glom(phyloseq_taxonomy_copy, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_rel   <- transform_sample_counts(ps_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Melt and clean
ps_melt <- psmelt(ps_rel)
ps_melt$Genus <- trimws(ps_melt$Genus)

# Identify top genera (mean abundance >= 1% across all samples)
# Collapse the rest into "Other"
genus_keep <- ps_melt %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(MeanAbund >= 0.01) %>%
  pull(Genus)

ps_melt <- ps_melt %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(Genus %in% genus_keep, Genus, "Other"))

# Order genera by overall mean abundance for legend/stack order
# Put "Other" at the bottom of the stack
genus_order <- ps_melt %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(MeanAbund) %>%
  pull(Genus)

genus_order <- c("Other", genus_order[genus_order != "Other"])
ps_melt$Genus <- factor(ps_melt$Genus, levels = genus_order)

# Define colours
n_genera <- length(levels(ps_melt$Genus))

genus_colors <- setNames(
  c("grey70", rainbow(n_genera - 1)),  # grey for "Other", rainbow for the rest
  levels(ps_melt$Genus)
)

# Plot — stacked bar per sample, faceted by farm status
p_stacked <- ggplot(ps_melt,
                    aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Genus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  facet_grid(~ Lived_on_farm, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colors, name = "Genus") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Genus-Level Gut Microbiome Composition in PD Patients",
    x        = "SampleID",
    y        = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    panel.spacing   = unit(0.3, "cm")
  )

print(p_stacked)

# Save
ggsave("genus_stacked_barplot_per_sample.pdf", plot = p_stacked,
       width = 18, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)

ggsave("genus_stacked_barplot_per_sample.png", plot = p_stacked,
       width = 18, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)

message("Stacked plot saved.")
```
